summary: Rabbi Harari discusses tax exemptions for Rabbanan and examines stories regarding Rav Shach alongside the commentary of Knesset Yechazkel. He analyzes the story of Ifra Hormiz sending coins to Rabbi Yosef and reviews discussions in Tosafot and Derisha about selling a Sefer Torah for Pidyon Shibuyim. He also explains the Gemara's source in Yirmiyahu for the severity of captivity and details the collection rules for Kupah and Tamchui.
questions: Who is considered a Talmid Hacham for tax exemptions according to Knesset Yechazkel?
Why is Pidyon Shibuyim considered a mitzvah rabba?
May one sell a Sefer Torah for Pidyon Shibuyim according to Tosafot and Derisha?
How did Rabbi Yosef handle the money sent by Ifra Hormiz?
What makes captivity more severe than other forms of death according to the Gemara?
What are the rules for collecting and dividing Kupah and Tamchui?
